prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1417; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the type and force of the impact. Presenting complaints involved the right knee, with pain, swelling, and limited range of motion. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the knee injury, and the patient's history reveals no prior injury to the same area. Conservative management was provided over twelve visits, consisting of physical therapy, joint mobilization, progressive strengthening, and home exercise instruction. Recovery was somewhat slower than typically expected for this type of injury, and the course of care extended beyond the usual timeframe. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicate charges. At the most recent evaluation, the patient had improved in strength and mobility but still reported intermittent discomfort with stairs and prolonged standing. Continued home exercise and activity modification were recommended.
